svg.title: Two lobes, two ways to turn
svg.desc: Rhythms 2 / 3 make a large gold lobe with winding count plus one and a little blue loop with count minus one. White arrows show their opposite directions. A close-up shows the narrow clockwise loop. Over a whole orbit the curve winds once around the center, while the tangent makes zero net turns.
svg.text: Two lobes, two ways to turn
Region labels count turns around an interior point. Both panels preserve the shape’s proportions.
